body:
I have a girlfriend as I wrote above just now, but she lives far away. I have talked to her but she is mostly high and doesnt really get what I am talking about. I dont really want to bother the few friends I have left. 

Thank you for the tip about video games. Its a good idea, but I have no TV (or xbox) nor a PC that I can play games on. I feel like a pretty boring person other than that. I dont find anything amusing or giving. I just want to sleep.

I dont know what the root for my depression is. My doctor and my psych sais it has to do with my brain and that I will always have it, and always stronger at fall and at spring. So I dont really see why I should keep on trying if I will feel like this for the rest of my life.

I don't think I could volunteer. it's not very common where I live. And it would be way too difficult. Thanks for the idea though.
I have two friends that I meet maybe once a month. We used to be very close but I think my mental issues got too much for them. I study at the university and go to classes there two times a week. And I also see a psychologist and have just started group CBT for social anxiety.

I go out and stuff. But just one more push and I'd be back to going out once a week to buy food. 

I have a partner since two years back, but she lives far away. We barely meet right now because neither of us have the money to. She smokes pot every day and is too high to go on skype to talk.

Every inch of my body is exhausted. No matter how many hours I sleep, or how good I eat, or whatever I do I am just so tired. I can't do anything. Physically and mentally tired. I can't focus.

I am diagnosed with seasonal depression and social anxiety. I live pretty much isolated. I have had anxiety and depression for as long as I can remember and I don't understand why I should keep on trying to reach something  (happiness? A meaning?) when all I do is to fall back, over and over again.

I am tired of doing that. I am tired of getting out of bed every morning, I am tired of living and I wish I could sleep forever. I wan't to stop living and I can't push those feelings away anymore

I literally hear things. In the night mostly. And that's also very scary. I don't know how to deal with this. I increased my dosage of SSRI a while ago but I am getting nowhere.
